career.name: Runesmithing

practice.award: 1 custom career point per unique settled, funded host-application order, capped at 450; never per new item output
requires: full listed reagent bill consumed and recorded by an authoritative application receipt
buyer- or guild-supplied compatible existing host; preserve its same item GUID
quoted commission fee paid by player, recipient, or guild treasury with a funded demand receipt
successful authoritative inscription application records the same host GUID, new inscription revision, exact recipe design, consumed input receipt, and active rune-channel state
delivery returns that same host GUID with the inscription to a distinct intended recipient character who has genuine equipment use; recipient may share maker account or guild, including a society bot
replacement application uses a different admitted design ID with a functional upgrade for the recipient, new revision, full bill and fee, and funded demand; only one inscription is active per host
durable settlement binds maker character, order unit, design, payer/funding receipt, recipient character, host GUID, inscription revision, input-consumption receipt and exact application receipt
practice.same_host_rule: The exact design ID may earn practice on a given host GUID once. Same-design removal/reapplication, refresh, no-op replacement, or wash never earns credit. A later distinct design can earn credit on that same GUID only as a genuinely useful recipient-requested functional upgrade under the replacement requirements.
practice.batch_rule: Each paid unit is one host application with its own order, input-consumption receipt, new inscription revision, exact application receipt, and delivery of the same host GUID. Replays are idempotent.

teaching.method: A qualified mentor supervises a learner with required lesson and career gates while the learner performs a real full-bill funded host application for a distinct intended recipient. The payer may be a guild treasury and recipient may share the learner account; the host GUID is preserved.
teaching.learner_reward: normal career point for the learner’s own uniquely settled application only
teaching.mentor_reward: one non-repeat teaching citation after the learner’s distinct settled application; ledger/fame only

specialties.requires: Three distinct settled field applications across at least two weapon patterns, including a hostile-spell pattern.
Three distinct settled applications across shield and body-armor hosts, including an ally-protection or heal pattern.

career.trainer_and_specialty_receipts: Bound to distinct paid work; non-repeatable, non-transferable, and not convertible to character power.

shared_rules.pattern: Exactly one shared-vocabulary trigger, transformation and release per recipe; combination admission remains explicit.
shared_rules.host: Buyer or guild supplies one compatible existing item separately; wearer level selects the variant, host native required level must be <= wearer, and native slot/class/proficiency plus recipe item-power budget/role must be compatible. Successful application preserves the exact host GUID, creates a new inscription revision/receipt, and produces no new item. One rune inscription is active per host; a different design replacement requires a funded, useful functional upgrade. Host is not in the reagent bill.
shared_rules.native_gates: Wearer level and host required level must both be within the recipe band. Preserve actual base item slot, class/subclass, class restrictions, native skill/level checks and wearer proficiency at order, completion and equip. Plate requires existing plate proficiency; shields require existing shield proficiency.
shared_rules.charges: All inscriptions are durable and have no charge counter, refill, or scheduled upkeep.
shared_rules.identity: Per-item ICD state persists through relog, trade, storage and equipment swaps. Duplicate copies of a design do not multiply one wearer's instance.
shared_rules.components: Copper, Iron, Mithril, Adamantite and Saronite Rune Blank plus Runic Binder are custom_unimplemented. Recipes consume blanks/binders OR raw expansion components, never both; these cards consume named components plus listed ordinary reagents only.
shared_rules.native_item_entry: null for every name reference; names are not admitted routes or sourcing claims.
shared_rules.client_and_policy: Native profession/client UI feasibility and default two-profession-limit policy remain unqualified and pending; no displacement or native activation is implied.
shared_rules.city_service: Quote complete bill, fee, station, active stages and delivery before accepting. City artisan benefit is fame and teaching eligibility only.
shared_rules.hostile_source_gate: Hostile proc sources are NPC-only. Player/PvP damage triggers remain excluded pending separate qualification. Genuinely injured allied heal recipients may be players or NPCs.
shared_rules.application_receipt: Award career credit only after unique authoritative same-host application and input-consumption receipts plus funded delivery to a distinct recipient character. Account or guild equality does not invalidate real society supply; maker-character self-recipient, repeated same-design host application, and wash/no-op replacements are ineligible.
